vocabulary.tts_text: Business casual means no jeans on client days.

vocabulary.example: Please wear appropriate clothing to meetings.

vocabulary.tts_text: Please wear appropriate clothing to meetings.

vocabulary.example: We can wear jeans on casual Friday.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What is the dress code here, exactly?
lines.text_cz: Jaký je tady přesně dress code?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's business casual, but you can be casual on Fridays.
lines.text_cz: Je to business casual, ale v pátek můžeš být neformální.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is a suit necessary for client-facing meetings?
lines.text_cz: Je nutný oblek na schůzky s klienty?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, we ask people to look appropriate for clients.
lines.text_cz: Ano, chceme, aby lidé vypadali pro klienty vhodně.
